If the option --all or -a is given, all available commands are printed on the standard output. If the option --guides or -g is given, a list of the Git concept guides is also printed on the standard output. If a command or other documentation is given, the relevant manual page will be brought up. The man program is used by default for this purpose, but this can be overridden by other options or configuration variables. If an alias is given, git shows the definition of the alias on standard output. To get the manual page for the aliased command, use git <command> --help .
